Arlecchino, also known by her codename "The Knave," is a playable Pyro character in Genshin Impact.

She is the Fourth of the Eleven Fatui Harbingers and the current head of the House of the Hearth. She is addressed as "Father" by members of the House, who she calls her "children."

Normal Attack
  • Description

  • Preview

Normal Attack
Performs up to 6 consecutive spear strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a fixed amount of Stamina, dashing toward a nearby opponent and cleaving once.
Continuously holding this button will cause Arlecchino to consume Stamina and engage in up to 5s of high-speed movement.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

Masque of the Red Death
When Arlecchino has a Bond of Life equal to or greater than 30% of her Max HP, she will enter the "Masque of the Red Death" state, where her Normal, Charged, and Plunging Attacks will be converted to deal Pyro DMG. This cannot be overridden.
When in the "Masque of the Red Death" state, Arlecchino's Normal Attacks will deal extra DMG to opponents on hit that scales off her ATK multiplied by a certain ratio of her current Bond of Life percentage. This will consume 7.5% of said current Bond of Life. Her Bond of Life can be consumed this way every 0.03s. When her Bond of Life is consumed in this manner, All Is Ash's CD will decrease by 0.8s.

  • Unlike all other Polearm users, Arlecchino's Charged Attack is not preceded by a Normal Attack.
  • The third hit of Arlecchino's Normal Attack will pull enemies towards her.
  • If Arlecchino wields any other polearm other than Crimson Moon's Semblance, her polearm will have a yellow scythe blade starting from the second hit of her Normal Attack combo.
  • While holding her Charged Attack and during her high speed movement, she will sprout a red wing and be able to fly over the surface of water.
  • Her Normal Attack AoE is increased during her "Masque of the Red Death" state.
  • Arlecchino remains in the "Masque of the Red Death" state even if she is swapped off field and swapped back in, so long as her Bond of Life is greater than 30% Max HP.
  • During the "Masque of the Red Death" state, the base damage of Normal Attacks is calculated as: ATK × ( Talent Multiplier + Masque of the Red Death Increase × Bond of Life Max HP ) {\displaystyle {\text{ATK}}\times ({\text{Talent Multiplier}}+{\text{Masque of the Red Death Increase}}\times {\frac {\text{Bond of Life}}{\text{Max HP}}})}
  • The on-hit 7.5% Bond of Life consumption during the "Masque of the Red Death" state is multiplicative.

Additionally, Arlecchino's interruption resistance is increased when she performs Normal or Charged Attacks while affected by the Masque of the Red Death."
  • Constellation Level 3, "You Shall Become a New Member of Our Family...": Increases this talent's level by 3, up to a maximum of 15.

All Is Ash
Elemental Skill
  • Description
  • Gameplay Notes
  • Advanced Properties
  • Attribute Scaling
  • Preview
Summons forth Balemoon Bloodfire, dealing Pyro DMG to multiple nearby opponents and performing a dash-cleave against one of them, dealing AoE Pyro DMG.
Opponents hit by the aforementioned attack will have a Blood-Debt Directive applied to them.

Blood-Debt Directive
  • Lasts 30s. Every 5s, it will deal 1 instance of Pyro DMG to the opponent. Max 2 instances. This DMG will be considered Elemental Skill DMG.
  • When Arlecchino uses a Charged Attack or her Elemental Burst, Balemoon Rising, she will absorb and clear nearby Blood-Debt Directives. Each Directive absorbed grants her a Bond of Life worth 65% of her Max HP.
  • The maximum value of the Bond of Life she can be granted through Blood-Debt Directives within 35s after using her Elemental Skill is 145% of her Max HP. Using the Elemental Skill again during this duration will restart the count on duration and the limit on the value of Bond of Life she may gain from Blood-Debt Directives.
  • When this skill hits at least one enemy, it generates 5 Elemental Particles.
  • Blood-Debt Directive DMG does not snapshot and will be affected by changes in Arlecchino's stats after the ability is cast.
  • Arlecchino obtains Invincibility Frames during this skill for the duration that she disappears.
  • To absorb nearby Blood-Debt Directives, Arlecchino only needs to initiate a Charged Attack. The Charged Attack does not need to hit and may be canceled, such as by dashing.
  • Arlecchino cannot absorb Blood-Debt Directives from Stormterror Dvalin.

    • Arlecchino will be granted a Bond of Life worth 130% of her Max HP when an opponent to which she herself applied a Directive is defeated.
    • 5s after a Directive is applied, it will be upgraded to a Blood-Debt Due. When absorbed, it will instead grant Arlecchino a Bond of Life worth 130%.
    A Bond of Life created in the aforementioned ways cannot exceed the original limit on the value of Bonds of Life obtained through All Is Ash."
Constellation Effects

When Arlecchino absorbs such a Due, she unleashes Balemoon Bloodfire in front of her, dealing 900% of her ATK as AoE Pyro DMG and increasing her All Elemental RES and Physical RES by 20% for 15s. This effect can trigger once every 10s. You must first unlock the Ascension Talent 'Agony Alone May Be Repaid.'"

Balemoon Rising
Elemental Burst
  • Description
  • Gameplay Notes
  • Advanced Properties
  • Attribute Scaling
  • Preview

Arlecchino's great wing of Balemoon Bloodfire beats as she absorbs and clears Blood-Debt Directives around her. She deals AoE Pyro DMG before clearing the CD of All Is Ash and healing herself. The healing is based on her Bond of Life value and ATK.

  • As Balemoon Rising does not remove Arlecchino's Bond of Life the healing granted by Balemoon Rising is absorbed by Bond of Life bringing the talent's effective healing to 50% of her Bond of Life and 150% of her ATK, excluding any healing bonuses.

  • Constellation Level 5, "For Alone, We Are as Good as Dead...": Increases this talent's level by 3, up to a maximum of 15.
  • Constellation Level 6, "From This Day On, We Shall Delight in New Life Together.": "The DMG of Balemoon Rising is increased by Arlecchino's ATK multiplied by 700% of Arlecchino's current Bond of Life percentage. For 20s after Arlecchino uses All Is Ash, both her Normal Attacks and Elemental Burst gain 10% increased CRIT Rate and 70% increased CRIT DMG. This effect can be triggered up to once every 15s."

1st Ascension Passive
  • Description

Blood-Debt Directives have the following characteristics:

Character Description[]

Arlecchino's Elemental Skill deals Pyro DMG to nearby opponents and applies Blood-Debt Directives to them for a period of time. After using her Charged Attack or Elemental Burst, she will absorb nearby Blood-Debt Directives, gaining a Bond of Life.
Arlecchino enters the "Masque of the Red Death" state when the value of her Bond of Life exceeds a certain percentage of her Max HP, causing her Normal Attacks to be converted to deal Pyro DMG and consume part of the value of her current Bond of Life to deal increased DMG based on her Bond of Life and ATK.
Her Elemental Burst deals AoE Pyro DMG, removing the remaining CD on her Elemental Skill and restoring her HP.
